text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Grey dots: the highest hourly power of each day, as a share of the plant's static power. Orange line: the estimator's capacity, also as a share of static power, which should sit near the top of the dots and drop where capacity is lost. Every panel uses one vertical range. Day 1 is the first day shown; no dates are given. Blue shading: the month in which the loss was planted. All rows are exploratory.'
